svg.title: AREA 34
svg.desc: The healing ring is behind the waterfall; break its high rock targets with techniques or a gun. Interact left, right, left, right as you advance, 1→4. These are switches to operate, not floor pads to walk over. Do not operate the four opposite switches; they trigger traps. This inset matches the map orientation. The center light resets after seconds. Leave one nearby to press it again, including while the party clears the next dark room; regroup afterward.
